original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Reproduce the 945-pairing control, then read Exact interface to list the allowed calls.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.
Extending a source-count census without naming a supplier/interface decision it could change; audit #2973 pruning concerns before relying on the affected predecessor exclusions.

actual_scope: Exactly five source labels and all 31 nonzero output masks of the universal dirty connector, with one added Q5 call z += sum_(j=0..4) B_j x_j usable at most once. Q5 costs one complete dispatch and five elementary source additions. Prove a lower bound against every readout count and compare it with the frozen singleton (12 source calls, 12 source additions) witness.
scope_change_reason: The card left the added operation and small instance open. This package fixes them to the all-five-source toggle and the existing five-source/31-mask universal batch, keeping the alphabet extension to one Q5 use and charging all five source additions.
bottleneck_link: A Q5 call attempts to replace several complete source calls with one dispatch in the recursive connector interface. The result prices five source updates and any extra output readouts, screening whether this operation can improve the completed root budget in the idealized model.
stop_rule: Enumerate the only odd singleton-source totals below 11: m=5, 7, and 9. Stop once the parity lower bound m>=11 and the two exact finite censuses exclude a Pareto gain; do not extend to repeated Q5 uses, other source counts, or a physical supplier.
evidence: For one Q5 use, connector restoration forces every singleton count m_j to be positive odd. The m=5 case has at most 20 nonzero two-boundary differences by the seven-prefix pair count; exact exhaustive orbit-reduced censuses over 33,600 m=7 and 1,159,200 m=9 labeled words attain maxima 20 and 27. Missing masks need at least four A readouts each. Thus Q5 cases require at least (90 queries,94 additions), (92,96), (80,84), or (74,78) for m=5,7,9,or m>=11, against the pinned (74,74) singleton witness. Reproduction: scripts/research_package.py --package research/quint-toggle-connector.
